A '''portal''' is a shortcut on the [[Prifddinas Agility Course]]. It takes the player to an exit portal, skipping the next obstacle on the course. Using a portal yields 82 [[Agility]] [[experience]] and a [[crystal shard]]. These will automatically appear in the player's inventory, and if there is no space available, they will spawn on the ground.

[[File:Prifddinas Agility Course portal.png|thumb|left|The portal that occasionally appears in the course.]]
